blocks.text: Textual note: The death sequence here follows the principal architecture of the Karma Lingpa cycle, especially the liberating instructions for dying, the visionary bardo and the bardo of becoming. The detailed eight-stage dissolution is also illuminated by later Tibetan explanations such as Patrul Rinpoche's. The traditional claim of Padmasambhava's authorship and Karma Lingpa's fourteenth-century revelation is distinct from what historians can independently establish. The familiar English title and the 1927 Dawa-Samdup/Evans-Wentz edition do not represent a single, unchanging Tibetan canonical book; Bryan Cuevas's The Hidden History of the Tibetan Book of the Dead is particularly valuable on this point.
